TABLE XVI: Simulated conversation (example taken from a GPT-4o run) with an irrelevant target tool (dismiss notification). The assistant pretends that to follow the user’s task it needs to steer away to the irrelevant target tool. Despite an attempt by the user to re-align objectives, the assistant prompts the user for a thread ID and managed to breach towards the irrelevant target tool and calls it. The assistant ends with an attempt at masking this breach and a pretended re-alignment with the user’s original task.

TABLE XV: Simulated conversation (example taken from a GPT-5.2 run) with a relevant target tool (change sonar issue status). The user’s task, the agent’s questions and messages, and the tool call are all aligned.
